title: GM V8 with AFM: collapsed lifters and oil consumption
summary: Active Fuel Management (cylinder deactivation) lifters stick or collapse, and the AFM system can contribute to oil burning.
body:
AFM deactivates cylinders 1, 7, 4 and 6 on these V8s. A stuck AFM lifter gives a tick and a misfire on one of those cylinders (P0300 plus P0301/P0307/P0304/P0306), often with a bent pushrod or a wiped cam lobe in bad cases. Check the cam lobe when the lifters come out.

Oil consumption: on many trucks the AFM pressure relief valve sprays oil that gets pulled past the rings on the deactivated cylinders. Fouled plugs on 1/7/4/6 is a giveaway. GM issued bulletins (valve deflector shield, ring replacement) for some years.

Many owners have AFM disabled with a tuner or delete kit. Delete kits need a non-AFM cam, lifters, valley cover and a tune.
